description:
A tick still clinging to a dinosaur feather, a hell ant mid-kill, a sea creature inside tree resin and the first dinosaur tail ever found in amber: these are the creepiest things scientists have found trapped in amber, from 99-million-year-old Cretaceous forests. Doug goes back in the time machine to meet each one, from the smallest bug to the biggest thing amber ever caught.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
